attestations.text: YÜ Yüeh 俞樾 (T. 蔭甫, H. 曲園), Dec. 25, 1821–1907, Feb. 5, scholar, was a native of Tê-ch'in, Chekiang. His father, Yü Hung-chien 俞鴻漸 (T. 儀伯, H. 1781–1846), was a chü-jên of 1816. His elder brother, Yü Lin 俞林 (T. 壬甫, H. 芝石, 柯九老人, 1814–1873), was a chü-jên of 1843 who rose in his official career to prefect of Fu-ning, Fukien (1870–73).
